title: joserfc: Compact JWS size guard allocates attacker-controlled segments before rejection (CVE-2026-119284)
description: joserfc version 3.2.4_2 up to but not including 4.1.2 has a vulnerability in its compact JWS size guard. The library calls bytes.split() on attacker-controlled input before validating size limits, causing it to allocate memory roughly equal to the payload size before rejecting oversized inputs. This can lead to increased memory usage and potential denial of service. A fix is available in version 4.1.2 that checks input length before splitting to prevent unnecessary allocations.
